description: Count driver licenses outstanding in California by county of residence, as an annual series from 2008 onward, with the statewide total and the statewide count of DMV ID cards. Answers "how many licensed drivers are in Los Angeles County", "which California county has the most driver licenses", or how a county's licensed-driver count has changed over time. Counts people holding a license, which is a different question from how many vehicles are registered — for that use ca_dmv_vehicle_registrations.

county.description: County name, matched as a substring, e.g. "Los Angeles", "Alameda".

year.description: Four-digit year from 2008 to the latest published (2024 as of October 2026), e.g. "2024". Defaults to the most recent.

name: ca_dmv_driver_licenses
title: Ca Dmv Driver Licenses
